source: No rotation period or spin axis of OGLE-LMC-ECL-10567 B is measured in the sources this package cites. The display axis is the normal of its hosted orbit in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/ogle-lmc-ecl-10567-b.json, computed by hostedKeplerElements in @cssearth/astronomy; the meridian is set so that grid longitude 0 faces the Sun and Earth at the scene epoch.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the display axis, the orbit normal; +X is the display meridian; east longitude. No spin is propagated.
qualification: Display convention, not a measurement: the spin axis, spin sense, period and prime meridian of OGLE-LMC-ECL-10567 B are unmeasured; the axis shown is its orbit normal.
